coverage_note: Read in full: No. 6 (Hua XV 81-90) with its subsections 'Two Forms of Fulfilment of the Perception of Others' and 'Supplementary Remarks'. No. 19: only the paragraphs containing 'fulfil', 'empty' or 'confirm'; none extracted. Not read: Appendices IV, XVI and XX, 'Recollection and Empathy', No. 20, the Theory of Empathy section and the rest of the volume's 212 term hits.

units.claim: The other's psychic life is given only significatively, and, per Husserl's later footnote, this appresentation can never become an actual presentation as a thing's back side can.
units.quote: Husserl's footnote, added later, states the decisive contrast: the significatively co-present is appresented, but this appresentation can never become an actual presentation as that of a thing's back side can.

units.claim: Non-intuitive significative understanding precedes any making-intuitive of the other's experience, so empathy as intuitive imagining is optional and secondary.
units.quote: Empathy in the narrow sense, intuitive imagining of the other's experience, is optional and secondary. The primary achievement is an empty, significative understanding.

units.claim: Fulfilment of the perception of others is two-layered, and fulfilment of the psychic layer is possible without intuition of the psychic, confirmed by the concordant course of the bodily layer.
units.quote: Husserl's note names the structure: fulfilment of the perception of others is two-layered, its lower layer being the process and horizon of fulfilment of mere body-perception; hence the continuous appresentation is two-layered too. Fulfilment of the psychic layer is possible without intuition of the psychic.

units.claim: Even in thing-perception the bulk of what is meant is fulfilled only in style, never intuitively, and horizon-fulfilment is the general structure the perception of others specifies.
units.quote: The thing-case supplies the model: even in thing-perception, the bulk of what is meant is fulfilled only "in style," never intuitively.

units.claim: The psychic meaning projects demands on the bodily course, and a bodily appearance that does not fit the demand cancels the positing.
units.quote: The psychic meaning projects demands on the bodily course, and the bodily course confirms or cancels the psychic meaning.

units.claim: Perception of others has two forms of fulfilment that are also levels: one without intuition, and one in which intuitive empathy is added to empty understanding confirmed in its course.
units.quote: The two forms are not alternatives but levels: empty understanding is complete as perception yet surpassable by intuitive empathy, which gives the other in the highest originality open to him.

units.claim: Confirmation of the psychic in another is the continuing unity of a total expression across manifold expressions, unlike thing-experience in which the appresented becomes actual by presentation.
units.quote: The bracketed supplement restates the paradox and gives the answer: confirmation of the psychic is the continuing unity of a total expression across manifold expressions.

units.claim: The commentary applies the 'threefold layering' of Formal and Transcendental Logic to expression, yielding three levels of fulfilment: grammatical unity of sense, logical compatibility, intuitive evidence.
units.quote: Applied to expression, it yields three levels of fulfilment: grammatical unity of sense, logical compatibility, intuitive evidence.

units.claim: Reading shows understanding fulfilling itself without intuition, through clarity of articulation.
units.quote: Reading shows understanding fulfilling itself without intuition, through clarity of articulation, and its passage from understanding to co-judging to critical evaluation.

units.claim: Little becomes properly intuitive in perceptual transitions, yet there is continuous fulfilment of the non-intuitive sense and co-meant horizons.
units.quote: Little becomes properly intuitive in these transitions, yet there is continuous fulfilment of the non-intuitive sense, the co-meant horizons.
